intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra greets you without a bow. It is friendlier than a bow. It is also a question.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I have thought about your proposal. It matters too much to pretend we understood each other.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I do not want to be a legend you kneel to. Or to have a guardian appointed to protect me from myself.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Can you see a life with the actual person standing here?”

options.labelText: “Yes. I made you a symbol, then a project. Wrong both times. I love the real you: capable, kind, sometimes tired, your own boss. Marry me?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You have learned to make a short speech.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand. Her smile has none of the court in it.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Yes, {PLAYER}. I choose you. As your equal, and as myself.”

options.labelText: “I can promise never to disagree with you. Or I can make all the decisions. Which would you prefer?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I guess I still don’t get it.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then I would rather wait than marry a misunderstanding.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She says goodbye kindly. The proposal stays where it is, unanswered.
